title: Block Diffusion for Longitudinal EHR: Accuracy, Efficiency, and Representation Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have proved effective for zero-shot prediction from longitudinal electronic health records, but impose strictly sequential generation on trajectories containing temporally clustered and interdependent clinical events. We investigate block-based masked diffusion (BD) as an alternative on MIMIC-IV under matched tokenisation, context length, model capacity, and evaluation conditions. Across block sizes, BD exhibits a clear quality--efficiency trade-off, with small-block configurations retaining much of the predictive performance of AR while enabling substantially faster inference. A representative $B{=}8$ configuration achieves approximately $1.43\times$ faster evaluation. translated_title: 面向纵向电子健康记录的块扩散模型：精度、效率与表示学习的权衡
translated_abstract: 自回归（AR）模型已被证明在基于纵向电子健康记录进行零样本预测方面非常有效，但其对包含时间上聚集且相互依赖的临床事件的轨迹施加了严格的顺序生成方式。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上，在匹配的分词方式、上下文长度、模型容量和评估条件下，研究了基于块的掩码扩散模型（BD）作为替代方案。在不同块大小的实验中，BD表现出明显的质量-效率权衡，小方块配置在保留AR大部分预测性能的同时，能够显著加快推理速度。一个具有代表性的B=8配置实现了约1.43倍的评估加速。尽管在大多数设置下生成式 rollout 仍不及AR，但在BD和AR表示上训练的冻结线性探针在各类临床预测任务中取得了几乎相同的性能，这表明BD学习到了具有可比信息量的临床表示。
tldr: 基于块的掩码扩散模型可作为自回归模型在纵向电子健康记录预测中的高效替代方案，小方块配置在保持接近AR预测性能的同时实现约1.43倍的推理加速，且学习到的临床表示信息量与AR相当。
en_tdlr: Block-based masked diffusion serves as an efficient alternative to autoregressive models for longitudinal EHR prediction, with small-block configurations achieving approximately 1.43× faster inference while retaining near-identical predictive performance and comparably informative clinical representations.
